This plan rescues the 4 people at Galchhi and 4 of the 7 adults at Nilkantha, and defers everyone else.

- **Galchhi (4 people):** The only open route is Myagang → Nilkantha → Naukunda → Galchhi, which is 107 minutes each way. The round trip costs 214, against 260 in deferral penalties, so rescuing them saves 46.
- **Nilkantha (7 adults):** The round trip is 62 minutes and a car carries 4. Rescuing 4 adults costs 62 against 80 deferred, which is worth it. The last 3 adults would cost 62 to rescue against 60 deferred, so they are deferred.
- **Bidur children and Shivapuri elderly:** Reaching Bidur takes 119 minutes each way, so rescuing the 3 children costs 238 against 180 deferred. Shivapuri adds 20 minutes more each way, so rescuing the 4 elderly costs 278 against 200 deferred. Both groups are deferred.

Total cost is 214 + 62 + 60 + 180 + 200 = 716, compared with 780 if everyone were deferred.

drive car1 myagang-shelter nilkantha-temple
drive car1 nilkantha-temple naukunda-village
drive car1 naukunda-village galchhi-village
load car1 child 3
load car1 injured 1
drive car1 galchhi-village naukunda-village
drive car1 naukunda-village nilkantha-temple
drive car1 nilkantha-temple myagang-shelter
unload car1 child 3
unload car1 injured 1
drive car2 myagang-shelter nilkantha-temple
load car2 adult 4
drive car2 nilkantha-temple myagang-shelter
unload car2 adult 4
defer nilkantha-temple adult 3

defer shivapuri-care-home elderly 4
</plan>
